limitations: Provider models are verified but no provider or route is a supported writer surface.
Network identities and the bounded bridge contract graph resolve through registry provenance review-accepted canonical references; route, relayer, quote, and writer review remains separate.

records.sourceEvidence: source transaction receipt with NTT TransferSent digest and transceiver send event
records.messageEvidence: Wormhole emitter-chain, emitter-address, and sequence tuple or a destination transceiver receive event
records.destinationEvidence: successful destination receipt containing NTT TransferRedeemed for the same transfer digest
records.failureRule: Absence of a VAA, destination receipt, or redemption event is pending or unknown until a provider-specific timeout/recovery policy supplies stronger evidence.
records.terminalSuccessRule: A successful source receipt is necessary but insufficient; completion requires a successful destination receipt with TransferRedeemed for the same NTT transfer digest.
records.replayRule: Duplicate attestations and message execution are source-defined replay-protected cases and must not be treated as a second transfer.
limitations: NTT manual/standard/special relaying modes are contract protocol configuration, not a UI automation guarantee.
Inbound and outbound rate limiting can queue an otherwise valid transfer.

records.sourceEvidence: Direction-specific AssetsLocked on Ethereum or AssetsUnlocked on Mezo, including the full provider sequence tuple.
records.messageEvidence: Inbound: inclusion in the validator-canonicalized sequence consumed by Mezo. Outbound: AssetsUnlockAttested on Ethereum for the matching source tuple.
records.destinationEvidence: Inbound ERC-20: matching Mezo system payload and sequence advancement plus recipient post-state delivery. Outbound: AssetsUnlockConfirmed plus exact gross/fee/net asset reconciliation.
records.failureRule: Absence of a canonicalized sequence, attestation, confirmation, or recipient post-state is pending or ambiguous unless direction-specific evidence proves a source revert or permanent failure. Do not apply NTT states or event names.
records.terminalSuccessRule: A successful source receipt is necessary but insufficient. Use the direction-specific delivery proof in native-lifecycle.json.
records.replayRule: Inbound source events are processed as a strictly increasing sequence; outbound Ethereum confirmation tracks the unlock sequence and confirmedUnlocks state. Duplicate-looking observations do not represent a second transfer.
limitations: The active Mezo client/source, precompile state, complete Ethereum proxy history, post-upgrade configuration snapshot, and two direction-specific transfers are verified; registry provenance review accepted the registry records, while current exact-call writer verification and route/security review remain open.
A successful logless Mezo system transaction does not alone prove an ERC-20 mint; post-state delivery evidence is required.
